content:
Create a premium cinematic 10-second vertical 9:16 Coca-Cola commercial using the provided image as the exact visual reference. Keep the same Coca-Cola plastic bottle, label, bottle shape, cap, colors, proportions, and branding perfectly consistent throughout the entire video. Ultra-realistic commercial quality, photorealistic textures, condensation, dramatic lighting, shallow depth of field, smooth professional camera movement.

SCENE 1 — 0–2s | PICK UP & REVEAL
Close-up of the same ice-cold Coca-Cola plastic bottle covered in realistic condensation and surrounded by ice cubes. A stylish man’s hand enters the frame and confidently picks up the bottle. Subtle slow-motion, cinematic highlights reflecting across the wet bottle.

SCENE 2 — 2–4s | OPEN
Medium close-up of the man holding the exact same bottle. He twists the red cap open with a satisfying “pssst” sound. Tiny carbonation bubbles and cool mist escape from the opening. Camera smoothly pushes in toward the bottle.

SCENE 3 — 4–6s | POUR
Cinematic close-up as he pours the Coca-Cola into a crystal-clear glass filled with ice cubes. The dark cola flows smoothly into the glass, creating realistic bubbles, foam, splashes, and condensation. Dramatic macro shot of the liquid hitting the ice.

SCENE 4 — 6–8s | DRINK
The man lifts the glass and takes a refreshing sip. Show a natural, satisfying reaction as he closes his eyes briefly and smiles, clearly enjoying the cold, refreshing taste. Keep the focus premium and authentic, not exaggerated.

SCENE 5 — 8–10s | HERO ENDING
He lowers the glass with a satisfied smile. Cut to the same original Coca-Cola plastic bottle standing beside the glass and ice cubes. Cold condensation glistens under dramatic red-and-black cinematic lighting. Slow camera push-in, beautiful reflections, subtle mist, premium beverage-commercial finish.

Visual style: ultra-realistic, luxury beverage advertising, cinematic 8K, HDR, realistic condensation and carbonation, dramatic red highlights, dark premium background, shallow depth of field, natural human movement, smooth transitions, realistic physics, high-end commercial cinematography.

Important: Preserve the exact original Coca-Cola bottle and label from the reference image. Do not redesign, morph, distort, replace, or change the bottle, logo, label, cap, or proportions. No extra text, no deformed hands, no duplicate bottles, no warped glass, no artificial-looking drinking motion.

실제처럼 차가운 동일한 코카콜라 플라스틱 병의 클로즈업. 병에는 사실적인 물방울이 맺혀 있고 주변에는 얼음 조각들이 둘러싸고 있다. 세련된 남성의 손이 프레임 안으로 들어와 자신감 있게 병을 집어 든다. 은은한 슬로모션, 젖은 병 표면 위로 반사되는 시네마틱한 하이라이트.

SCENE 2 — 2–4s | OPEN  
남성이 정확히 같은 병을 들고 있는 미디엄 클로즈업. 그는 빨간 캡을 만족스러운 “pssst” 소리와 함께 돌려 연다. 병 입구에서는 작은 탄산 방울과 차가운 미스트가 새어 나온다. 카메라는 부드럽게 병 쪽으로 푸시인한다.

그가 얼음 조각이 담긴 맑고 투명한 유리잔에 코카콜라를 따르는 시네마틱 클로즈업. 짙은 콜라가 잔 안으로 부드럽게 흘러 들어가며 사실적인 기포, 거품, 튐, 응결을 만들어낸다. 액체가 얼음에 닿는 순간을 담은 드라마틱한 매크로 샷.

SCENE 4 — 6–8s | DRINK  
남성이 잔을 들어 상쾌하게 한 모금 마신다. 잠시 눈을 감고 미소를 지으며 차갑고 상쾌한 맛을 분명히 즐기는, 자연스럽고 만족스러운 반응을 보여준다. 과장되지 않게, 프리미엄하고 진정성 있는 느낌에 초점을 유지한다.
